title: Torsion, Betti rank, and small points in semiabelian schemes
summary: Let $\mathcal G\to S$ be a semiabelian scheme over a smooth complex algebraic base, with abelian relative dimension $g$ and toric rank $r$. We prove that a dominating irreducible subvariety not contained in a proper relative special subvariety has Zariski-dense fibrewise torsion if and only if its mixed Betti rank is $2(g+r)$. In particular, its dimension is at least $g+r$. For every prime, primary torsion is then dense even among points of maximal rank. The exceptional loci include generalized Ribet loci.
